_help: Short paragraph under the newsletter header, labelled WEBSITE UPDATE: the due entries' text joined in order of from date, then key, then one 'Have a look at thelenches.org.uk.' link (render.js). So write each text as one or two plain sentences that read well joined to others: no 'New on the website:' and no 'Have a look'. Each entry: key (unique, letters/numbers/hyphens, never reused), from (first issue date it can appear, YYYY-MM-DD), optional until (last date), text, link (kept for the record; not shown). Shown in one issue that is sent live, then retired automatically.

entries.text: This newsletter comes from website@thelenches.org.uk. To make sure it keeps reaching your inbox, please add that address to your contacts.

New on the website: a fresh look, events and news from around the Lenches updated daily, church service times with links to each Sunday's Bible readings, and your bin days. Have a look at thelenches.org.uk.

The website has a new home page with an illustrated map of the villages, a Notices page for news from around the villages, and a Roads page with a map of closures and roadworks and a slider to see what's on any day in the next 8 weeks.
The menu at the top of every page is now a row of buttons, and on phones a Menu button opens it.
The Events page now shows a picture beside each event.
There's also a new 'What to do if…' page saying who to call for power cuts, gas leaks, flooding, lost pets, fly-tipping, potholes and blocked footpaths.
The Events page now shows a picture beside each event, and you can now join this newsletter straight from the website: enter your email and click the link we send you.

The website has had a refresh. The home page now opens with Events, Notices, Bins and newsletter sign-up, with the Community and Living here sections below, and the menu is a row of buttons (a Menu button on phones) with a new Search page. There's a Notices page for parish council notices and news from around the villages, a Roads page with a map of closures and roadworks and a slider to see any day in the next 8 weeks, and a 'What to do if…' page saying who to call for power cuts, flooding, lost pets, fly-tipping, potholes and more. The Events page now shows a picture beside each event, every page has a 'Suggest an update' box for anything wrong or missing, and you can now join this newsletter straight from the website.
